analysis: P8 frozen prediction versus existing measured outcomes; no flights, no model refit
frozen_search: find repository and /home/car -name p8_frozen.json; no file found in accessible paths; unreadable directories not claimed searched
unit: 900 unique campaign/method/sut/search-seed/round identities; full case and realized config budgets cross-checked; aborts retained
exploration: 24 T1 runs separate; 18 in-domain and 6 restored<0.1s out-of-domain; reused seeds not independent
split: random baseline only; within each SUT sort sha256('P8-frozen-check-v1|'+run_id), first 45 calibration, remaining 45 test; all other methods evaluation only
conformal: only with verified original model and original error rule; one-sided 90% residual bound quantile ceil((n+1)*0.9); no computation when frozen source missing; coverage, skip fraction and skip-set failure rate separate
intervals: two-sided nominal 95% Wilson binomial intervals, descriptive only under dependent/adaptive observations; no causal or simultaneous claims
phase_hypothesis: T0 run-level any planned restored interval in inclusive [0.4,0.6]s versus none in [0.1,0.8]s; stratify method and interruption count; realized adjacent resume-to-next-last-reception durations audited separately; no outcome-driven cutoffs
prediction_blockers: if missing/hash mismatch: all prediction/error/underestimation/skip/conformal results NA, not zero; do not fabricate or reconstruct frozen predictions
budget: each execution compare historical closed-form, offline list, recorded budget and actual run config; any difference excludes frozen horizon comparison until original predictor horizon known
checks: input hashes before and after, counts 900/432/511, CSV rounding, identity uniqueness, 1080 offline list execution status, 376 preserved prefix, exploration domain counts, links, deterministic regeneration
